warnings: Relative target 'target_is_below_area_norm' appears to vary over time for 40.1% of cells overall, but that movement is SIMULATION NOISE, not signal: only 0.8% of Ookla-ANCHORED cells ever change state, versus 99.1% of UNANCHORED cells. Anchored cells are deterministic (level x one shared curve), so a common positive factor cannot reorder them; unanchored cells carry a np.random.normal term in their level that reshuffles the ranking every hour. Do not read the aggregate figure as evidence that the panel carries spatio-temporal information — it does not. This resolves only when the shape itself varies spatially (real per-district curves) or when a genuinely time-varying real source replaces the panel (e.g. multi-quarter Ookla, which gives real per-cell change without needing an hourly source).
target_is_degraded positive rate is 1.65% — severe class imbalance; the modelling team should use class weighting / PR-AUC, not plain accuracy.
0.595% of rows have target_next_1h_valid == 0 (end-of-series warm-up, no future observation) — these must be dropped before training on the corresponding next-hour target, not treated as label 0.

target_is_degraded_next_1h positive rate is 4521.73x higher for Ookla-anchored cells (2.75%) than for unanchored cells (0.00%) — a large enough gap that anchor status carries real predictive signal about the label independent of genuine demand/QoE patterns. Consider reporting metrics split by qoe_level_is_ookla_anchored.

sunway_ground_truth.why_withdrawn: sunway_test_event_dl_raw carries the raw GNetTrack TESTDOWNLINK value with an unverified unit (TESTUPLINK reads ~10x higher than TESTDOWNLINK; read as Mbps the values exceed this dataset's own passive throughput peak of 103.9 Mbps in the same cells). Separately, only 8 cells overlap with real Ookla coverage, at a median of 8 test events each. Neither the unit nor the sample size supports a correlation claim.
sunway_ground_truth.to_reinstate: Resolve TESTDOWNLINK against the GNetTrack Pro field specification, apply the conversion in ingest_sunway_real.load_real_sunway_points, then report the comparison as DESCRIPTIVE at n=8 — never as validation of Ookla.

independent_ground_truth_coverage.statement: Independent real multi-operator field measurements exist for these cells and nowhere else in the study area. This is a genuine, disclosable coverage fact and does not depend on the unresolved unit question.
